name: Atlas
source:
Atlas is the second love interest in Lovewood. He is a strong and calm fairy who loves to cook and has a food delivery service with Nord, who frequently visits him. 
Atlas lives a little way off the main town, in a cottage in the forest. He is known to occasionally help out during events by cooking for the royal court.

He also makes an appearance as one of the two main characters in When Trees Turn to Ice.
